prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1121; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms and the force of the impact. Over the course of 23 visits, care proceeded along a typical rehabilitation pathway, including physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and periodic reassessment. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms improved and function returned. Examination revealed findings that support a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, including tenderness and reduced strength with specific resisted movements, while other orthopedic and neurological tests were within normal limits. There is no record of prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder. Billed services align with the documented care plan, with no duplicated or repeated charges identified. The patient is currently improving and is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued home exercise and periodic follow-up as needed.
